title: Spider Exception when sitemap.xml not found

milestone.description: Enhancements and bug fixes expected to be included in the next main release.

body:
I encountered the following when doing some basic functionality testing against Apache in XAMPP Portable (xampp-portable-win32-5.6.23-0-VC11). > 47011 [Thread-10] INFO org.zaproxy.zap.extension.spider.SpiderThread - Starting spidering scan on SpiderApi-0 at Thu Aug 04 21:05:24 EDT 2016 > 47011 [Thread-10] INFO org.zaproxy.zap.spider.Spider - Spider initializing... > 47026 [Thread-10] INFO org.zaproxy.zap.spider.Spider - Starting spider... > [Fatal Error] :2:10: DOCTYPE is disallowed when the feature "http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl" set to true. > 47074 [pool-1-thread-2] ERROR org.zaproxy.zap.spider.parser.SpiderParser - An error occurred trying to parse sitemap.xml > org.xml.sax.SAXParseException; lineNumber: 2; columnNumber: 10; DOCTYPE is disallowed when the feature "http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl" set to true. > at com.sun.org.apache.xerces.internal.parsers.DOMParser.parse(DOMParser.java:257) > at com.sun.org.apache.xerces.internal.jaxp.DocumentBuilderImpl.parse(DocumentBuilderImpl.java:347) > at org.zaproxy.zap.spider.parser.SpiderSitemapXMLParser.parseResource(SpiderSitemapXMLParser.java:105) > at org.zaproxy.zap.spider.SpiderTask.processResource(SpiderTask.java:293) > at org.zaproxy.zap.spider.SpiderTask.run(SpiderTask.java:240) > at java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor.runWorker(ThreadPoolExecutor.java:1145) > at java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor$Worker.run(ThreadPoolExecutor.java:615) > at java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:745) > 47106 [pool-1-thread-1] ERROR org.zaproxy.zap.spider.parser.SpiderParser - An error occurred trying to parse sitemap.xml > org.xml.sax.SAXParseException; lineNumber: 2; columnNumber: 10; DOCTYPE is disallowed when the feature "http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl" set to true. > at com.sun.org.apache.xerces.internal.parsers.DOMParser.parse(DOMParser.java:257) > at com.sun.org.apache.xerces.internal.jaxp.DocumentBuilderImpl.parse(DocumentBuilderImpl.java:347) > at org.zaproxy.zap.spider.parser.SpiderSitemapXMLParser.parseResource(SpiderSitemapXMLParser.java:105) > at org.zaproxy.zap.spider.SpiderTask.processResource(SpiderTask.java:293) > at org.zaproxy.zap.spider.SpiderTask.run(SpiderTask.java:240) > at java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor.runWorker(ThreadPoolExecutor.java:1145) > at java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor$Worker.run(ThreadPoolExecutor.java:615) > at java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:745) > [Fatal Error] :2:10: DOCTYPE is disallowed when the feature "http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl" set to true. > 47387 [pool-1-thread-2] WARN org.zaproxy.zap.spider.URLCanonicalizer - Error while Processing URL in the spidering process (on base ): Host could not be reliably evaluated from: https://),url(https://),red > 47387 [pool-1-thread-2] WARN org.zaproxy.zap.spider.URLCanonicalizer - Error while Processing URL in the spidering process (on base ): Host could not be reliably evaluated from: https://) > 47450 [pool-1-thread-2] WARN org.zaproxy.zap.spider.URLCanonicalizer - Error while Processing URL in the spidering process (on base ): Host could not be reliably evaluated from: https://),url(https://),red > 47450 [pool-1-thread-2] WARN org.zaproxy.zap.spider.URLCanonicalizer - Error while Processing URL in the spidering process (on base ): Host could not be reliably evaluated from: https://) > 50055 [pool-1-thread-1] WARN org.zaproxy.zap.spider.URLCanonicalizer - Error while Processing URL in the spidering process (on base ): Host could not be reliably evaluated from: http://codemirror.net), > 56374 [pool-1-thread-2] INFO org.zaproxy.zap.spider.Spider - Spidering process is complete. Shutting down... > 56389 [Thread-11] INFO org.zaproxy.zap.extension.spider.SpiderThread - Spider scanning complete: true Attempting to access sitemap.xml actually returned a 404, based on the following response (header & body): ``` HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found Date: Fri, 05 Aug 2016 01:05:24 GMT Server: Apache/2.4.17 (Win32) OpenSSL/1.0.2d PHP/5.6.23 Vary: accept-language,accept-charset Accept-Ranges: bytes Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8 Content-Language: en Object not found!
